title: RegistryConnection
description: A private package or container registry that Vulnetix scans may read, and how to authenticate to it: an npm registry, a PyPI index, a Maven repository or an OCI registry. The credential is kept in the tenant's secrets vault (a connector entry), never in the connection; a scanner asks the platform to resolve the connection for a registry host and a package, and the credential is opened and the open recorded in the vault activity log. A connection with a username authenticates with basic authentication and the secret as the password; without one, the secret is a bearer token. Apply checks the credential against the registry before storing it and refuses a login the registry rejects. This is separate from the paid container registry logins on the Integrations page, which the crawler uses. Needs the saas migration 20261228020000_scan_registry_connection; until it is applied, plan refuses a document naming it.

ecosystem.description: oci: a container registry. npm: an npm registry. pypi: a PyPI simple index. maven: a Maven repository.

url.description: For oci, the registry host with an optional port (registry.example.com, ghcr.io, registry.example.com:5000). For the others, the https URL of the registry or index (https://npm.pkg.github.com/, https://pypi.example.com/simple/, https://maven.example.com/releases/). It is matched against the registry a scan reaches by host.

scope.description: The packages or repositories this connection serves. Left out, every one at the registry. npm: a scope (@acme). oci: a repository path prefix (acme/payments). maven: a group id prefix (com.acme). pypi: a project name prefix (acme-). When several connections serve one registry, the most specific scope wins.

username.description: The user for basic authentication, with the secret as the password. Left out, the secret is a bearer token (an npm automation token, a registry access token).

secret.description: The password or token, read on the client and sent once. Required when the connection is created; left out afterwards, the stored credential is kept. It is stored in the secrets vault and never exported or shown in a plan. Changing it stores a new version of the vault entry.

enabled.description: False keeps the connection and its credential but stops scans using it.
